text: Following up on the pgvector decision from February 3rd. We load tested at 2M vectors and p99 latency hit 800ms, which is 4x over our 200ms budget. Decision: we are migrating the embedding store from Postgres/pgvector to Qdrant. This supersedes the February 3rd pgvector decision.
Confirmed, I'm on board. pgvector was the right call at 200k vectors, it just does not hold at 2M. Qdrant it is.
